At the 2022 annual conference of the Japan Association of Economic Law, held at Kyoto University, I gave a presentation based on my book *Reconstructing the Concept of Exclusion in Private Monopolization*.

Thank you for the many valuable questions.

It was a pity there was no reception after I had finally given my presentation, but I enjoyed being back at Kyoto University after a long time.

I think this settles my book-related work for now. All that remains is to write an article on a new theme before the end of the year.
